parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this Flow table entry.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this Flow table entry. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: URN identifying the type of flow to be associated with the specified policer. A set of defined URNs is given in {{bibref|TR-181i2|Annex A}}.

parameters.name: TypeParameters
parameters.description: Each entry is a name-value pair representing additional criteria to identify the flow type. The use and interpretation is specific to the particular FlowType URN.Encoded using the "x-www-form-urlencoded" content type defined in {{bibref|HTML4.01}}.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Human-readable name associated with this entry in the Flow table.

parameters.name: App
parameters.description: {{reference}} Indicates the ''App'' table entry associated with this flow. {{empty}} indicates the flow table is not associated with any App table entry.

parameters.name: ForwardingPolicy
parameters.description: Identifier of the forwarding policy associated with this flow.

parameters.name: TrafficClass
parameters.description: Identifier of the traffic class associated with this flow.

parameters.name: Policer
parameters.description: {{reference}} Indicates the ''Policer'' table entry for traffic that falls in this flow. {{empty}} indicates a null policer.

parameters.name: DSCPMark
parameters.description: DSCP to mark traffic with that falls into this flow. A value of -1 indicates no change from the incoming packet. A value of -2 indicates automatic marking of DSCP based upon the EthernetPriority value of the incoming packet as defined in {{bibref|TR-181i2|Annex A}}.

parameters.name: EthernetPriorityMark
parameters.description: Ethernet priority code (as defined in {{bibref|802.1Q-2011}}) to mark traffic with that falls into this flow. A value of -1 indicates no change from the incoming packet. A value of -2 indicates automatic marking of EthernetPriority based upon the DSCP value of the incoming packet as defined in {{bibref|TR-181i2|Annex A}}.

parameters.name: InnerEthernetPriorityMark
parameters.description: Ethernet priority code (as defined in {{bibref|802.1Q-2011}}) to mark the inner VLAN Tags with for traffic that falls into this flow. A value of -1 indicates no change from the incoming packet. A value of -2 indicates automatic marking of EthernetPriority based upon the DSCP value of the incoming packet as defined in {{bibref|TR-181i2|Annex A}}.
